description: Source code for a video decoder class implementing decoding of HEVC/H.265 video streams using the libde265 library, with support for decode-to-texture and decode-to-video frame output modes.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: A class for decoding HEVC/H.265 video streams using libde265, supporting different output modes and managing decoder lifecycle.

methods.name: VideoDecoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the video decoder with specified codec, output mode, and graphics context provider.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with callback functions for status and error reporting.

methods.name: WriteInputBuffers
methods.description: Feeds input buffers into the decoder for processing.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to flush remaining frames.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state and clears queued frames.

methods.name: UpdateDecodeTarget_Locked
methods.description: Updates the decode target with the current frame in decode-to-texture mode.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Creates and starts the libde265 decoder and worker threads.

methods.name: TeardownCodec
methods.description: Frees decoder resources and releases decode targets.

methods.name: DecodeOneBuffer
methods.description: Processes a single input buffer, pushing data into the decoder.

methods.name: DecodeEndOfStream
methods.description: Flushes the decoder to process remaining data.

methods.name: ProcessDecodedImage
methods.description: Decodes available frames, creates video frames, and manages callbacks.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decoded frame as a decode target in decode-to-texture mode.
